principles: No top-N subclass/component heuristic before canonical filtering.
Current path is always retained as a control candidate.
Every rejection carries machine-readable reason codes.
Inventory support is evaluated from owned item mechanics/orbs, not only currently equipped gear.
Selectable capability matches are weaker than guaranteed matches.
Efficiency pruning may remove dominated level splits but must preserve material breakpoints.

relevant.pass_rule: current OR any inventory/orb support OR material high-value capability with nonzero owned-item intersection
relevant.note: RELEVANT is contextual; static catalog stores features, runtime supplies owned inventory.

efficient.dead_dip_rule: 1-level component with no unique owned requirement, proficiency, high-value capability, or spell contribution is dominated
efficient.breakpoint_source: frozen capability graph; union material signature change by class/entry mode
